comparison.objective: Move four visually identical, differently weighted crushable cups; candidate transfers an uncaged bearing block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests payload inference and adaptive grip-force control against slip and crushing. Candidate tests bimanual alignment, force-limited precision sliding, and free-ball containment.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires all cups upright and released on a tray with no buckling, slip, drop, tilt, or forbidden grasp. Candidate requires intact ball inventory and uninterrupted rail-to-jig support through complete transfer.
comparison.reason: Force care is generic; adaptive gripping of compliant containers is a different tested ability from preserving a bearing circulation system across a support junction.
